race.comment: BOHEMIAN STAR (1) has raced twice to date, unplaced on debut then improved to finish second last time over 1200m at this track, beaten a long neck. Good chance to break through with further progression in a race that has taken a hit from scratchings. TENNESSEE LIGHTS (10) ran a better race last start at her second trip to the races, finishing fourth over 1000m at this track. She'll be up on speed and hard to run down in a race without a stack of pressure. HOT POT DOT (7) is a filly by Tassort on debut for the O'Sullivan yard who has jumped out nicely here, that synthetic track experience should hold her in good stead.  FAKE FICTION (5) got into the placings fresh and will take catching with the added fitness.
